source: User-confirmed interface mapping; update only with user-confirmed facts

fields.warning: Do not label this indicator as health or HP. Values are dynamic.

fields.meaning: HP of the mercenary selected for the current mission
fields.position: To the left of the genetic chain
fields.warning: HP differs between mercenaries and can change. 110 is an example, not a fixed value. Do not label HP as ammunition or AP.

fields.meaning: Pain-threshold units of the selected mercenary
fields.position: Immediately to the left of the health indicator
fields.warning: Do not confuse this with HP, calories, ammunition, or action points. If unreadable, report unknown.

entity_classification.player_controlled: The mercenary currently controlled by the player; keep separate from friendly NPCs.
entity_classification.enemy_npc: Any NPC not controlled by the player that has a clearly visible red health bar directly above or visually attached to that NPC.
entity_classification.friendly_npc: Any NPC not controlled by the player that has a clearly visible green health bar directly above or visually attached to that NPC.
entity_classification.unknown: If the health bar is absent, obscured, too small, or cannot be spatially associated with a specific NPC, classify allegiance as unknown.
entity_classification.important_warning: The interface contains many green elements. Never classify an NPC by finding green pixels anywhere on the screen. First identify a candidate NPC, then inspect only the small area immediately above / attached to that NPC for its health bar. Do not infer allegiance from the NPC name or type.

notification_rules: A notification about a named entity describes that entity, not the selected mercenary, unless the identity is explicitly confirmed.
A message that an entity suffers a wound applies to that named entity, not automatically to the player.
Distinguish the selected mercenary, friendly NPCs, enemy NPCs, and robots.
